scores.tell: Busy, sparkly water with many small ripples and a sprawling lifebuoy reflection covers half the card. Real scenes use fewer, larger, quieter shapes.
Very close to real. The only tell is slightly uniform glossy glass rings and small scattered stars and pebbles.
Chunky, toy-like pier posts and planks with large flat orange faces and faint grain. The rope coil and lifebuoy are oversized.
Slightly pillowy, swollen lobes and an airbrushed glow on the ribs. The staging matches the real cards.
Lacquered black plastic engine with hard gloss streaks, shot from a low wide angle with exaggerated rails. The desert is cluttered with bushes and rocks.
Same as c214: a glossy black plastic boiler, forced wide-angle perspective, and busy track and desert clutter.
Hard to tell from real. It has the soft broad sheen and flat tone-on-tone pattern backdrop of the towel card.
Slick plastic look: a flat teal gradient disc, a hard white hot spot on the green dome, and glossy bead lights. It floats small, with no form detail.
Matte clay-like blue-gray slab with almost no form shading or highlights. The orange gradient wall and flat yellow floor are bare. It reads like a different, vector-3D style.
Busy scene with trees, path, flowers and two stools that compete with the table, plus a dense checkerboard. The rendering is otherwise close to the real swing card.
